propositions: A new AST gate must detect and flag prohibited config/credential reads (categories 1–6: ambient env, helper-shim, load_config, literal-getattr, provider-credential, backend-reload) in non-approved modules, with deterministic diagnostics (path/symbol/access-kind/owning-seam).

The gate must reuse gen_env_registry's env-read detection machinery (scan, KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS, _is_os_environ, _str_literal) as a single source, adding new logic for callee/receiver alias resolution and load_config/backend_registry detection.

Owner sets must be derived at runtime from existing registries (_child_env.owned_secret_names, @register decorator scan, gen_env_registry.scan + _deprecations.REGISTRY), with composition roots and provider-credential boundaries enumerated as distinct seam sets, rejecting path-glob exceptions structurally.
Dynamic env reads, shim-shaped callees absent from KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS, and newly declared env-names lacking owners must fail closed (unresolved-env-read diagnostic).
A legacy-exception set must enumerate current below-seam reads so the gate is introducible without product-code changes; C3 drains it to empty.

The gate must run offline with no network/CI dependency, expose check(root)->list[str] and main(argv)->int, be unit-tested with synthetic fixtures for all 6 categories and direct/import-aliased/local-aliased call forms, and exit 0 on the current tree.
